topics.topic: Which start-check subsets must be re-run after token-list config re-read before accepting/refusing requests
questions: On token-list re-read, which start checks must pass before requests are accepted again: all start checks, or only token-specific parse/length/uniqueness checks?

On config change during runtime, which "start checks" must be re-evaluated before refusing all requests: only token-list parse/length/uniqueness, or also file security checks and non-token config validity?

topics.topic: Case-sensitivity of credential-name vs required-header collision detection
questions: Is the credential-vs-required-header name collision check also case-insensitive, or exact-case only?

topics.topic: Definition of 'most recent NodeExecutions' and slot-scoped record inclusion in repair view
questions: How are "most recent" and "that slot's" determined: by store order or timestamp, and do records include only function-node executions whose executed contract belongs to the slot or also related skipped/upstream records?

topics.topic: Deterministic multipart part emission order across multiple input ports/files
questions: When several input ports are present, in what exact order must multipart parts be emitted (across ports and files) so different implementations produce the same wire request?

topics.topic: Exact RNG API call sites that must be trapped as sandbox violations
questions: Exactly which `random`/`SystemRandom`/`Random` call sites must be trapped to raise `sandbox_violation`?

topics.topic: Outcome when non-2xx HTTP responses exceed service_response_bytes_max
questions: If status is 3xx/4xx/5xx and body exceeds `service_response_bytes_max`, which outcome applies?

topics.topic: Precedence/consumption rules when both EffectApproval and StandingGrant exist on resume
questions: If both an unused approved EffectApproval and an active StandingGrant exist for the same waiting element at resume time, which authority must be consumed/recorded for the resend?

topics.topic: Required write ordering for simultaneous mapped-element status records
questions: If multiple elements of the same mapped node (same `node_id`, different `map_index`) become `upstream_failed`/`skipped_by_guard` together, what is the required write order among those element records?

topics.topic: What constitutes an 'unchanged' binding for proof repeatability guarantees
questions: What exactly counts as a binding being "unchanged" for this guarantee: only binding record content/status, or also external manifest entry content/digest reachable through that binding?
